title: Encryption at rest
intro: The project's files become unreadable on disk without the passphrase: project.json, images, thumbnails, series and the audit log. It does not protect the project while it is open —the key is in memory then, the only way the canvas can draw anything— and it is not regulatory compliance: HIPAA or the GDPR also require access control, processing agreements and breach notification, which a desktop application cannot guarantee on its own.
noReturn: Point of no return: a lost passphrase is a lost project. There is no recovery and there cannot be one, because a back door would work just as well for whoever copies the disk. Write the passphrase down, or keep the shared key somewhere safe.
datasetInClear: Prepared datasets and trained models (the training/ folder) stay in the clear: Python reads them, and Python cannot decrypt. A prepared dataset is an unencrypted copy of the corpus sitting next to the encrypted one.
tooShort: Too short: eight characters is the minimum, and a long phrase beats a strange password.
mismatch: The two passphrases do not match.
publicLabelDesc: The only thing visible about the project while it is closed. Without it the project shows no name: the real one can say more than it should on a lost laptop.
rememberDesc: Stores the key in the system keyring and the project opens by itself. More convenient and less protective: anyone with your session open gets in without the passphrase.
slotsDesc: Each entry is a different passphrase over the same key. Removing one does not affect the others; the last one cannot be removed.
shareDesc: Hand the project key to whoever works on the same dataset: on their machine they put their own passphrase on top and the data stays encrypted on both sides.
keyWarning: Anyone holding this key can read the whole project, now and forever. Pass it through a secure channel and keep it as you would the passphrase: it is also the only backup against forgetting it.
disableDesc: Leaves every file in the clear on disk. The passphrase is required even if the project is open.
